children: Isabella Bank announced it will acquire Grand River through a multi-step merger with closing expected in Q4 2026, subject to regulatory approvals.
Isabella, Merger Sub and Grand River executed a merger agreement to combine Grand River into Isabella via a two-step merger and subsequent bank merger.
Grand River shareholders approved the merger at a special meeting on September 18, 2026.
Transaction completion expected in Q4 2026, contingent on regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions.
Company warns of typical merger risks including integration, cost realization, dilution from stock issuance and potential delays or additional costs.
